signal: Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR and is expanding into Canada, Europe and Asia while running leaner after early-2025 cuts

email.body1:
Brenden, saw Placer.ai push past $100M ARR and start expanding into Canada, Europe, and Asia.

Expansion like that piles up more in-market accounts than any rep can follow up on by hand, especially running lean. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so an SDR's output scales without adding seats: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Brenden, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

With new regions opening, response speed and follow-up volume usually become the bottleneck before ramp catches up. The right structure matters: tighter 75-100 word emails alone tend to lift reply rates 67%.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and our best practices that usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Brenden, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other SDR teams at scaling startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brenden, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling your outbound output without adding seats is not a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters, and an expansion push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR team? I will tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
